name: Siege and Capture of Antioch
summary: The First Crusade's eight-month siege of Antioch succeeds when a Frankish traitor opens a gate. The crusaders take Antioch but are immediately besieged by a relief army. Inspired by the discovery of the Holy Lance (whether genuine or fraud), the starving crusaders sally out and rout the Muslim forces. The episode reveals crusader psychology: religious ecstasy combined with pragmatic military skill.

_quarry.structural_significance: The capture of Antioch demonstrates crusader military resilience; the Holy Lance episode shows how religious psychology drives crusader behavior; the Principality of Antioch becomes the most culturally hybrid crusader state.
